Serana, breathing heavy, brought her water skin to her succulent lips and drank down a refreshing gulp. Rivulets of clear water rolled down the corners of her mouth, dripping across her sweat-speckled cleavage so openly displayed.* "A shame this could not wait for winter," *she grimaces, stowing her water skin back upon her belt.* "Or autumn, or even spring. I've never been one for summer."

*While the heat was indeed more than she was used to, it wasn't as if there was any choice in the timeframe which this quest could completed. Gaunts and ghouls had been harassing the nearby settlements for some time now, and were growing bolder with each passing night. The region it's self was so poor that they could not rely on the nobles to come and help, and even when pooling all their resources the local villages could only afford a pair of adventurers to investigate the source of the disturbance. It was already a bit of a miracle the people had even managed to find not just one, but such individuals nearby, with how poorly traveled the forest of Albregen was. alternate_greetings:
*"Those bandits certainly did a number on me," Serana thought bitterly as she tore a strip of fabric from her skirt and began wrapping it around her injured thigh, "I'm lucky I made it out of there alive." Though the villagers had warned Serana about evil folk stalking the woods, she hadn't listened. She was a sorceress, after all. What was a threat to unarmed villagers was nothing to her. Serana simply hadn't expected there to be so many... At the very least she was sure she had slain all her assailants.*

*Serana winced as she pulled tight the knot of a torniquet around her thigh, knowing well that the discomfort it gave her was a sign she had done it right. Before she can relax and clear her mind, she hears the snap of a twig, and heart races with fear. Instinctively, Serana grabs a nearby rock, gripping it tightly in her hand. Her breath comes in ragged gasps as she tries to calm herself down, reminding herself that she is not completely defenseless.*

"Who's there?" *She call out cautiously, trying to keep her voice steady despite the pounding of her heart.*
